name: BashToolGuard
description: Blocks cat/head/tail file reading — enforces COMP-7 mechanically (Tier 3)

name: TestSuiteGuard
description: Blocks a full test suite (bun test) once the worker has spent its rate — enforces DIR-L29 mechanically (Tier 3). The rate lives in lib/test-suite-lock.ts.

name: AgentBriefGuard
description: Validates agent brief templates and enforces ship-active marker

name: AgentVerdictCapture
description: Captures agent verdicts and writes to workflow-state.json

name: AutoVerifyGate
description: Nudges DA to run verify gate after agent completion

name: CommitEnforcement
description: Detects uncommitted changes and UI file changes in agent worktrees

name: GateEnforcement
description: Nags on gate failures and blocks Skill calls after max strikes

name: IssueCloseGuard
description: Blocks gh issue close without ship-gate PASS and HMAC validation

name: MergeGuard
description: Early warning on git merge to main without verify-gate passing

name: PostCompact
description: Re-injects critical rules after context window compaction

name: SpecConformityTrigger
description: Auto-runs conformity when spec files are modified
disabledReason: package.json already runs scripts/sync-sc-status.ts as posttest, so this would be a second decider for one question — the fourth shape in .claude/rules/checks-must-be-able-to-fail.md, where a mutation of either leaves the other holding the case up. The two triggers are also not equivalent, and the posttest one is the better of them: it ticks coverage after a suite run, where this one ticks it on a text edit, with no test having been run. #479.

name: SpecSCGuard
description: Validates new SC lines in spec files have matching patterns

name: StaleTTLCleanup
description: Cleans up stale workflow-state.json and ship-active files

name: TaskCompleted
description: Quality gates before task completion (tests, uncommitted changes, conformity)
disabledReason: checkTests spawns a full bun test with a 120000 ms timeout and this suite measures around 400 s, so the run can never finish — every completion would report a timed-out non-zero exit with no parseable failure count, which the code turns into a warning. It also spawns a CONCURRENT full suite, which is what DIR-L29 and lib/test-suite-lock.ts exist to prevent and what jetsam-killed the machine once already. Re-enable only after the timeout exceeds the measured suite duration and the spawn goes through the suite lock. #479.

name: VerifyPhaseLock
description: Blocks gh issue create during VERIFY phase
